detector: HSV yellow housing, blue panels with dark slots, elongated low-saturation metal candidates
socket_identity_rule: Require visible 1 USB + 3 AC row; target outlet 3 is farthest AC from USB
confidence: Unvalidated candidates <=0.5; no empirical confidence claimed
missing_required_features: UNKNOWN -> UNRESOLVED after deadline -> NO_ACTION; critical event HOLD
scope: Transport endpoint plus all align/insert frames, all three cameras; observations within each Episode are correlated, not independent trials
stop_rule: No usable relative feature stream => observation contract failure / NO-GO; no residual or paired trials
